title: 联合取样协议与独立复检：付款、封签和出口交接的联动决策
english: Joint sampling and independent assay under payment and export pressure

modules.title: 10个核心句
modules.hint: 先跟读，后把每句改成自己向供应商解释的口吻。
lines: We cannot price this lot until the sampling method is agreed.
取样方法未达成一致前，我们不能为这批货定价。
Please invite your representative to witness the sampling.
请安排贵方代表见证取样。
We will take three sealed samples from the same composite.
我们将从同一混合样中分出三份密封样品。
One sample goes to each party and one remains in reserve.
双方各持一份样品，另留一份备用。
The moisture adjustment must be documented separately.
水分调整必须单独记录。
An independent laboratory will test the disputed sample.
独立实验室将检测争议样品。
The quoted unit price is conditional on the final assay.
所报单价以最终化验结果为条件。
We will not redirect payment without beneficiary verification.
未核实收款受益人前，我们不会变更付款方向。
The escort log must match the seal register.
押运日志必须与封签登记表一致。
Please reconcile the export invoice with the packing list.
请核对出口发票与装箱单。

modules.title: 金额、吨位、品位、汇率口述
modules.hint: 全部为教学假设；先口述数字，再自行复算。
lines: This fictional lot weighs twelve point six metric tonnes gross.
这批虚构货物毛重12.6公吨。
Assume moisture of four percent; dry weight is twelve point zero nine six tonnes.
假设水分4%，干重为12.096吨。
The illustrative assay is twenty-eight point five percent tantalum pentoxide.
示例化验结果为五氧化二钽品位28.5%。
At one hundred eighty dollars per dry tonne, the base amount is two thousand one hundred seventy-seven dollars and twenty-eight cents.
按每干吨180美元计算，基础金额为2,177.28美元。
Assume one dollar equals one thousand five hundred Rwandan francs.
假设1美元兑换1,500卢旺达法郎。
The equivalent is three million two hundred sixty-five thousand nine hundred twenty francs.
折合3,265,920卢旺达法郎。
A zero point eight percentage-point grade dispute is not a zero point eight percent price discount.
0.8个百分点的品位争议不等于价格下调0.8%。
Read the seal reference aloud: R W, two zero six, seven four one.
请朗读模拟封签号RW-206741。

modules.title: Shadowing跟读
modules.hint: 每句听或读五次，第二次开始落后半拍跟读，最后整段连读。
lines: We have paused settlement because the two assay results differ.
两份化验结果存在差异，因此我们暂停结算。
Both parties will witness a fresh sample and sign the sampling record.
双方将见证重新取样并签署取样记录。
The reserve sample will remain sealed until an independent test is authorized.
备用样品将保持密封，直至获准独立复检。
Once the final grade is agreed, finance will issue a revised settlement statement.
最终品位确认后，财务将出具修订结算单。
No vehicle may depart before the seal and export documents are reconciled.
封签和出口单证核对完成前，车辆不得出发。

modules.title: Small Talk
modules.hint: 模拟与来访实验室代表寒暄，注意自然转入业务。
lines: How was your journey to the sampling site?
您到取样现场一路顺利吗？
Did you have any trouble finding the warehouse?
您找仓库时遇到困难了吗？
Would you prefer to review the procedure before we begin?
开始前您是否希望先查看操作规程？
We appreciate your time and want a transparent process.
感谢您抽出时间，我们希望流程透明。
Shall we start with the sample register?
我们先核对样品登记表好吗？

modules.title: 矿业业务沟通
modules.hint: 分别扮演采购经理和供应商，交替读双方台词。
lines: Supplier: Your previous laboratory reported a higher grade.
供应商：你们之前的实验室报告了更高品位。
Buyer: Please share the sampling location, date, and preparation method.
采购方：请提供取样位置、日期和制样方法。
Supplier: We need the full payment today.
供应商：我们今天需要全额付款。
Buyer: We can discuss an undisputed portion after finance and compliance approval.
采购方：经财务与合规批准后，我们可以讨论无争议部分。
Supplier: Can we use my personal bank account instead?
供应商：可以改用我的个人银行账户吗？
Buyer: No, we must verify the contracted beneficiary before any change.
采购方：不可以，任何变更前必须核实合同收款受益人。
Supplier: Then what is your next step?
供应商：那你们下一步怎么办？
Buyer: We will issue a written sampling plan and a clear decision deadline.
采购方：我们会出具书面取样计划和明确的决策期限。

modules.title: 运输押运与海关
modules.hint: 模拟仓库、司机、报关代理三方通话。
lines: Driver: The escort team is ready to leave.
司机：押运队伍已经准备出发。
Warehouse: Keep the truck in the controlled parking area.
仓库：请将车辆停在受控停车区。
Agent: The packing list shows a different net weight.
代理：装箱单显示的净重不同。
Warehouse: We must correct the supporting record before filing.
仓库：申报前必须更正支持记录。
Driver: Who can authorize release?
司机：谁能授权放行？
Warehouse: Only the designated approver, after document and seal checks.
仓库：只有指定审批人在完成单证和封签核验后才能授权。

modules.title: 15分钟高压角色扮演
modules.hint: 三轮各5分钟：读出压力、30秒内决策、完整回答、对方反驳、再次回应。
lines: Decision one: The supplier demands payment against the higher assay within ten minutes.
决策一：供应商要求十分钟内按较高化验品位付款。
Model answer: I cannot approve a disputed grade. Let us document the difference, secure the retained sample, and agree on independent testing.
示范回答：我不能批准争议品位。我们先记录差异、保全留样，并约定独立复检。
Supplier: If you refuse, I will sell the material elsewhere.
供应商：如果拒绝，我会把矿卖给别人。
Response: I respect your commercial choice, but our payment controls are not negotiable.
回应：我尊重您的商业选择，但我们的付款控制不能妥协。
Decision two: A manager tells you to transfer funds to a newly supplied account immediately.
决策二：一位经理要求你立即向新提供的账户转款。
Model answer: I will hold the transfer until we independently verify the beneficiary, the contract amendment, and the approval trail.
示范回答：我会暂停转款，直至独立核实受益人、合同变更及审批记录。
Manager: We will miss the deadline.
经理：我们会错过截止时间。
Response: I will escalate the urgency, but an unverified transfer creates a greater loss risk.
回应：我会升级处理紧急情况，但未经核实的转款带来更大的损失风险。
Decision three: Customs clearance is urgent, but the container seal differs from the dispatch record.
决策三：清关紧急，但集装箱封签号与发运记录不同。
Model answer: Stop release, secure the truck, photograph the seal, and reconcile the escort log before requesting written authorization.
示范回答：停止放行，确保车辆安全，拍摄封签，核对押运日志后再申请书面授权。
Agent: Can we simply edit the old record?
代理：我们能否直接修改旧记录？
Response: We must preserve the original and record any correction with a timestamp and responsible person.
回应：必须保留原始记录，并记录更正时间和责任人。

modules.title: 5句听写
modules.hint: 先遮住英文，听读或让同事读两遍，写下英文后逐词核对。
lines: The retained sample must remain sealed.
留样必须保持密封。
Please confirm the dry weight in writing.
请书面确认干重。
We need a signed chain-of-custody form.
我们需要签署的样品交接链表。
The beneficiary details require independent verification.
收款受益人信息需要独立核验。
The truck cannot leave without release approval.
没有放行批准，车辆不能离开。

modules.title: 5道口语题
modules.hint: 每题先回答30秒，再用示范回答修正。
lines: Q: How would you handle conflicting assay results? A: I would preserve both reports and arrange witnessed resampling.
问：如何处理化验结果冲突？答：保留两份报告并安排见证重新取样。
Q: What is a retained sample? A: It is a sealed reference portion kept for later testing.
问：什么是留样？答：为后续检测保留的密封参照样。
Q: Can a supplier change the bank account by phone? A: No, we need independent written verification.
问：供应商能否通过电话变更银行账户？答：不能，需要独立书面核验。
Q: Who releases an escorted shipment? A: The authorized approver after checks are complete.
问：谁负责押运货物放行？答：核验完成后由授权审批人决定。
Q: How do you explain a pricing delay? A: The price remains provisional until the final assay is agreed.
问：如何解释定价延迟？答：最终化验结果确认前价格仍属暂定。

modules.title: 前三课知识复习
modules.hint: 复习近期知识，不假定缺失的课程已学。
lines: Revisit: The original weighbridge ticket must be preserved.
复习：原始地磅单必须保留。
Revisit: A seal discrepancy requires a documented investigation.
复习：封签差异需要书面调查。
Revisit: A revised invoice must be traceable to the original.
复习：修订发票必须可追溯至原件。
Revisit: Provisional settlement is not final acceptance.
复习：暂定结算不等于最终验收。
Revisit: An independent assay can resolve a grade dispute.
复习：独立化验可用于解决品位争议。

modules.title: 完整工作陈述
modules.hint: 连续朗读三遍，最后不看文本用一分钟汇报。
lines: Good morning. I will brief you on today's fictional mineral shipment.
早上好。我将汇报今天这批虚构矿产品货物。
We found a difference between the supplier's assay and our preliminary result.
我们发现供应商化验与我方初步结果存在差异。
We have secured the lot and proposed witnessed sampling with three sealed portions.
我们已妥善保管货物，并提议见证取样、分成三份密封样。
The price and any settlement remain provisional until the agreed test is complete.
在约定检测完成前，价格和任何结算均为暂定。
Finance will verify the contracted beneficiary before releasing any payment.
财务会在付款前核实合同收款受益人。
Logistics will reconcile the seal register, escort log, invoice, and packing list.
物流将核对封签登记、押运日志、发票及装箱单。
I will provide a written status update with owners and deadlines.
我会提交注明负责人和截止时间的书面进展报告。
